messages.content: The maintenance config is needed for 'sandcastle'.

function.name: get_maintenance_configs
function.description: Retrieve a list of all maintenance configurations for the system, including details such as configuration name, description, and active status. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: MaintenanceConfigurationApi_get_maintenance_config
function.description: Retrieve the maintenance configuration settings for a given system or application identified by an ID. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

id.description: The unique identifier of the system or application for which maintenance configuration is being retrieved.

function.name: get_maintenance_configs_v2
function.description: Retrieve all available maintenance configurations, including details about scheduled times, affected systems, and notification preferences. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

page.description: The page number of the results to retrieve, for paginated responses.

page_size.description: The number of maintenance configurations to return per page.

filter_status.description: Filter configurations based on maintenance status.

sort_order.description: The order in which the maintenance configurations should be returned. Ascending or descending.
